notes.title: Steam Launch Online Tournament Event
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184205/f89974e3046b491b64824caa797477c845a71de2.png
AWARDS

 Top Score Award – USD$50
 - Awarded to the participant with the highest score screenshot and video posted.
 Most Helpful Player Award – USD$50
 - Awarded to the participant deemed most helpful to other players in the community Discord.
 Community Contribution Award – USD$50
 - Awarded to the participant in the community Discord with the best community contribution for Beast Brawl.



All decisions on the distribution of awards are at the discretion of the organisers and final.


HOW TO JOIN?

[olist]
 Join our community Discord
 Record and post a public video of your Beast Brawl playthrough to YouTube.
 Take a screenshot of your final score screen and post it with your video to the “Launch Tournament” channel in our community Discord before the tournament deadline.
 Participate in the community Discord to discuss and hang out with other players for a chance to win additional awards!
[/olist]

Please refer to the “Rules for Submission” section for detailed rules.


RULES FOR SUBMISSIONS


 Gameplay must be done on the latest version of the game (R01).
 Game can be played on any difficulty (chill or tryhard, but take note that chill mode has a 0.5x modifier for score).
 Gameplay video must be uploaded as a public YouTube video. Main submitted video may be edited, however a full unedited playthrough video must be uploaded and linked to in the description. The unedited video may be set as unlisted.
 Full playthrough video must show the entire playthrough from start (the start screen) to finish (final score shown), without any cuts or edits. Final score must be clearly visible. Commentary or captions are allowed as long as they do not obscure any vital information or break information continuity.
 Screenshot of the final score screen must be shared along with a link to the video submission in the RATH community Discord “Launch Tournament” channel under the “Beast Brawl” section.



Full details can be found here:
https://rathsoft.com/bbtournament


We look forward to your submissions!
